# Joseph & Rusty

- [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) — Friend of — [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) — went from sworn enemies to sworn friends who slept on the same cushion · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P65](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0065)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends settle into Patty's Place alongside [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) and her cats, [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) and the [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md). Before leaving [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) faces mixed reviews about her published story and adopts a stray cat, [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), whom they fail to chloroform. Eventually, [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) arrives to chaperon the household with a relaxed attitude toward their independence.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVI Adjusted Relationships

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P2](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0002), [v3 ch.Relationships P44](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0044), [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053)_

> [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) settles into Patty's Place with her two cats, [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) and the [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md). [The Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md) quickly establishes dominance over [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), while [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) and [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) engage in repeated battles before eventually becoming close friends. The household chats comfortably about house duties and Aunt Jamesina's humorous views on cats and life.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVI Adjusted Relationships

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 ch.Relationships P58](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0058), [v3 ch.Relationships P62](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0062), [v3 ch.Relationships P65](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0065)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) chat in the living room on Anne's twentieth birthday. [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) comes downstairs in her party dress to admire herself in the mirror and join the conversation about her various suitors and future prospects before leaving for a dance. Afterwards, [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) briefly discuss Phil's quirky disposition.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XIX An Interlude

_Sources: [v3 ch.Interlude P0](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0000), [v3 ch.Interlude P7](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0007), [v3 ch.Interlude P24](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0024), [v3 ch.Interlude P36](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0036)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives news that a publisher accepted her sketch, bringing excitement to Patty's Place. While on a walk, [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) announces his mother and sisters will visit, unnerving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Roy's family arrives a day early on Friday, creating chaos, but the awkward visit ends with Roy's sister [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) bonding with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).
>
